_: FITLOG_SLEEP_P2. Against the reconstructed FITLOG_SLEEP_P1 build no
temperature name is in METRIC_MAP, so every temperature case stores
nothing, and there is no overnight_metrics(), so the night carries no
Three assertions guard properties that build ALSO satisfied, or would
have failed against for a trivial reason -- the function simply did not
exist -- rather than because the property was violated. Those go under
mutation control, which is the stronger evidence.
M_unitguess -- guess that an unknown temperature unit is Celsius, so a
Kelvin reading is filed under a name ending _c.
M_basis     -- label a day figure as measured over the night, which is
the whole point of the basis field. Assertion 07.
M_zerofill  -- report a metric the Watch never sent as 0 instead of
leaving it out. A zero blood oxygen on a sleep page
reads as an event. Assertion 10 must catch it.

assertions.name: 01 wrist temperature is mapped and stored
04 a thermometer reading is stored and never merged
06 an overnight figure is averaged over the samples
08 resting HR and HRV are carried on the night
09 nothing the night carries is a score
11 time in bed sums the stretches
03 a temperature in an unknown unit is dropped

mutation.why: an unconvertible temperature unit is guessed at as Celsius instead of dropped, so a Kelvin reading is filed under a canonical name ending _c

assertions.name: 07 a figure not measured inside the night says so

mutation.why: a day figure is labelled as measured over the night, which is exactly what the basis field exists to prevent

assertions.name: 10 a metric the Watch never sent is absent, not zero

mutation.why: a metric the Watch never sent is reported as 0 rather than left out; a zero blood oxygen on a sleep page reads as an event
mutation.find: missing = [m for m in names if m not in out]
